responsibility: Defines RTL machine-description support for MIPS-provided custom instructions in the RISC-V backend. In this snapshot its role is focused on the `xmipscmov` extension: it adds a conditional-move `define_insn` that maps GCC `if_then_else` register selection on zero/nonzero tests onto the `mips.ccmov` instruction when `TARGET_XMIPSCMOV` is enabled, supplying the instruction-selection layer for that vendor extension rather than its option metadata or scheduling model.
